cover_headline: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to 60,000 Employees Across Four Countries

end.headline: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to 60,000 Employees Across Four Countries
end.line: The Voluntary Exit Offer covers about a quarter of Microsoft's 223,000-person workforce in the U.S., Canada, India and the U.K., with decisions due in the first week of December.

facts: The Voluntary Exit Offer covers about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of Microsoft's 223,000-person workforce
The offer covers eligible staff at level 70 and below on participating teams in the United States, Canada, India and the United Kingdom
The package equals Microsoft's standard severance, including base pay by tenure and level, continued stock vesting and healthcare for a fixed period

quote.role: Microsoft Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
quote.speaker: Amy Coleman
quote.text: This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support.
